we were able to optimize the Chebysheve based FMM for asymptotically and oscillatory smooth kernels, such that it outperforms the classical FMM for the Laplace kernel in terms of speed and memory usage.
the M2L operator of the Chebysheve FMM can be accelerated by a factor up of 340, and that this speedup can be achieved by a factor of 2.5 by the use of the proposed optimizations.

we have developed a fast and accurate method to compute the Chebysheve interpolation based FMM for a large class of kernel functions, and we have optimized the M2L kernel to reduce the computation time by a factor of up to 340.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the M2L operator is reduced from O(n^2) flops to O(n log n) flops.
the FMM for oscillatory kernels is now as fast as the FMM for asymptotically decaying kernels.
we were able to reduce the M2L precomputation time for a 3D problem of size 100^3 by a factor of 340, from 2.7 to 0.08 seconds, and the M2L product time by a factor of up to 2.7.

the precomputation cost can be reduced by up to 340x by using the proposed optimizations, and the matrix-vector product cost can be reduced up to 1.5x.
the M2L precomputation can be reduced to the same level as for other FMMs, while the matrix-vector product is accelerated.
